detail.longDescription: GHManage 0.9.5 is out. You now decide what each list says, and in what order. View > Columns… opens one dialog for every list: choose its columns, move them with Alt+arrow keys, and turn spoken column names on or off. GHManage remembers your choices. Headings are plain words now ("Commit", not "sha"), and Full mode skips names that add nothing. Also new: All branches in Commits. https:// github.com/TheIdeaPlace/GHMana ge/releases/tag/v0.9.5 # Accessibility # ScreenReader # GitHub # A11y
